description: This file defines a template class 'LinkType' for managing JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket connections, including nested classes for communication channels, message handling, and connection management. It also includes a 'SmartLinkType' class for higher-level management and event subscription, primarily used for remote plugin communication within the WPEFramework JSONRPC namespace.

classes.name: LinkType
classes.description: A template class managing JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket, including message handling, connection management, and event subscription within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: SmartLinkType
classes.description: A higher-level class providing managed connections, event subscriptions, and plugin state handling for remote JSON-RPC plugins.

classes.name: CommunicationChannel
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication, message sending, receiving, and connection lifecycle within LinkType.

classes.name: ChannelImpl
classes.description: Implements the core WebSocket client communication channel, inheriting from Core::StreamJSONType.

classes.name: FactoryImpl
classes.description: Singleton factory for creating and managing JSONRPC messages and watchdog timers.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents an individual pending RPC call, supporting synchronous and asynchronous responses, timeouts, and aborts.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Manages registration and invocation of JSON-RPC methods, supporting thread-safe operation.

classes.name: Statechange
classes.description: JSON container for plugin state change events.

classes.name: CurrentState
classes.description: JSON container for current plugin state information.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Represents a managed connection with event subscription, plugin state monitoring, and remote plugin control.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a singleton instance of CommunicationChannel.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a client for communication and event subscription.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a client from communication and event subscription.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a message for transmission over the WebSocket.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Returns the next scheduled timeout for pending RPC calls.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a registered method with parameters, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous calls.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an event with a callback.

methods.name: Monitor_response
methods.description: Handles plugin monitor responses for state updates.
